about.title: About Peachcade
about.p1: Peachcade is your premier destination for free, instant-play browser games. We bring together a diverse, curated collection of high-quality titles across action, puzzle, arcade, strategy, and casual genres.
about.p2: All games run directly in your web browser with no downloads, installs, or plugins required. Whether you are playing on desktop, tablet, or mobile, you can jump straight into the action anytime, anywhere.
about.p3: Join our community of players: track your favorite games, save your play history, compete for top scores, and share your reviews with other gaming enthusiasts worldwide.

home.aboutTitle: Play Free Online Games on Peachcade
home.aboutP1: Welcome to Peachcade, your modern destination for free browser games. Our library hosts thousands of HTML5 titles across action, puzzle, racing, shooting, sports, board, and casual genres. Every game runs directly inside your web browser — no downloads, no installs, and no registration required.
home.aboutP2: Built for fast play on desktop, tablet, and mobile, Peachcade features responsive controls, instant loading, and a clean interface. Create a free account to save favorites, continue where you left off, and climb the leaderboards. New games are added continuously, so check back often for fresh releases.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Peachcade ("we", "us") collects, uses, and safeguards information when you visit peachcat.fun.
privacy.p1: Account data you provide when registering (username, email address, hashed password) and optional profile details. We never store passwords in plain text — they are hashed with bcrypt.
privacy.p2: Usage data such as pages viewed, games played, likes, favorites, comments, and approximate aggregate statistics. We also receive standard server logs (IP address, user agent, timestamps) for security and abuse prevention.
privacy.p3: We use a small number of first-party cookies: a signed session cookie to keep you logged in, a CSRF token cookie to protect forms, and a language preference cookie. No advertising identifier is set by us directly.
privacy.p4: This site displays advertisements through third-party ad networks. These partners may use cookies or similar technologies to measure ad performance and, where consent is given, personalize ads. Their processing is governed by their own privacy policies. You can manage consent through the cookie banner when it is shown in your region.
privacy.p5: Account records are kept while your account is active. You may request deletion of your account and associated personal data at any time by emailing wyjv58787@gmail.com. We will action verified requests within 30 days.
privacy.p6: Peachcade is not directed at children under 13. If you believe a child has created an account, contact us and we will remove the data.
privacy.p7: For any privacy question or request, email wyjv58787@gmail.com.
terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: By accessing Peachcade you agree to these Terms of Use. If you do not agree, please stop using the site.
terms.p1: Peachcade is a free directory of browser games. Games are provided by third-party developers and publishers and are embedded or linked from their own hosting. We do not claim ownership of third-party games, artwork, or trademarks.
terms.p2: You are responsible for keeping your login credentials secure and for all activity under your account. Do not impersonate others, scrape the service at scale, or attempt to disrupt it.
terms.p3: You may not upload unlawful content, harass other users, post spam, or attempt to bypass security controls. Comments that violate these rules may be removed and accounts may be suspended.
terms.p4: Games, advertisements, and external links are operated by third parties. We are not responsible for their content, availability, or practices. Report broken or inappropriate games to wyjv58787@gmail.com.
terms.p5: The service is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. To the maximum extent permitted by law, Peachcade is not liable for indirect or consequential damages arising from use of the site.
terms.p6: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.
